description_en: Adds one or more materials to an online editing project
description_zh: 将一个或多个素材添加到剪辑工程中
name: AddEditingProjectMaterials

parameters.description_en: The ID of the online editing project.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the online editing project
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description_en:
The material ID. Separate multiple material IDs with commas (,). Each type supports up to 10 material IDs. The following material types are supported:

- video

- audio

- image

- liveStream

- editingProject
parameters.description_zh:
素材ID，多个素材以逗号（,）分隔；每种类型最多支持10个素材ID
- "video": 视频
- "audio": 音频
- "image": 图片
- "liveStream": 直播流
- "editingProject": 剪辑工程
